Rules.InvariantScript:
// Navigate to report form based on status
If(
    ThisItem.Status.Value = "Not Started",
    Navigate(scr_ReportForm, Fade, {selectedActivityID: ThisItem.ActivityID}),
    ThisItem.Status.Value = "Active" || ThisItem.Status.Value = "Rejected",
    Navigate(scr_ReportForm, Fade, {selectedActivityID: ThisItem.ActivityID, editReportID: ThisItem.ReportID}),
    ThisItem.Status.Value = "Completed",
    Navigate(scr_ReportView, Fade, {viewReportID: ThisItem.ReportID})
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
// Navigate to report form based on status
If(
    ThisItem.ReportStatus = "Not Started",
    Navigate(scr_ReportForm, Fade, {selectedActivityID: ThisItem.ActivityID}),
    ThisItem.ReportStatus = "Draft" || ThisItem.ReportStatus = "Rejected",
    Navigate(scr_ReportForm, Fade, {selectedActivityID: ThisItem.ActivityID, editReportID: ThisItem.ReportID}),
    ThisItem.ReportStatus = "Approved",
    Navigate(scr_ReportView, Fade, {viewReportID: ThisItem.ReportID})
)
